temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December15,2022snapshots,not seasonal means/annual extrema/historical occupations or climatology.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native longitude columns;minimum native-supported span where boundaries are censored. All80cases in one cumulative descriptor query.
window_interpretation: Adriatic0–30m,AlaskaCoastal0–100m,Hiri/Zeehan0–200m are original core/selection strata,not current thicknesses,depth caps,beds,instrument limits or observed whole layers. Surface-current naming does not add a positive surface gate.
layer_metric_interpretation: Thickness is lower minus upper,not absolute lower depth,core depth,search endpoint,seabed or sampled limit. Historical strict reaches and property/sample layers are not imposed boundaries.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional first-to-last contiguous native support under original piecewise-linear signed-component model,not physical current thickness bounds. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket sampling scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: Separate Adriatic surface branches are not dense-water/gyre/channel paths or unresolved Dalmatian aliases. Shelikof coastal component is not offshore Alaska/Alaskan Stream or wholeGulf. Hiri Australian branch is not whole PNG arc or downstream NGCUC. Zeehan regional component is not additive parent Australian boundary system and inherits no parent depths. Original declared identity context retained;absent Adriatic parent fields remain undeclared/null,not invented false inheritance declarations.
axis_anchor_interpretation: 65original model axis proxies and15explicit null gaps retain original candidate diagnoses;no replacement core,date,branch,gate or source.
interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified named-current axis,water mass,flow-normal width,whole-route depth,terrain clearance or physical water volume. No between-section physical interpolation or additive bodies.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU;original fields and qualifiers retained.
